## What's new

**Mine or the team's.** A saved query and a dashboard are in one of two places, and the *Saved* tab shows which: **This computer** or **Team**.

- New dashboards and saved queries stay on your computer. *Share with the team* puts one into the connection's knowledge base as a plain file (`dashboards/<name>.md`, `queries/<name>.sql`), where everyone who has that folder finds it; *Keep on this computer only* takes it back. Each asks once who will have it afterwards.
- In 1.5.3 a new dashboard of a connection with a knowledge base went into that folder by itself. It no longer does; dashboards already there stay shared.
- Queries shared through a team folder (`Team/…`) are in the same Team group.
- **The knowledge base shows what it holds**: Notes, Dashboards, Queries and AI tools as sections of their own, and each row opens as what it is.

**Charts follow the appearance.** The first series takes your accent color, or the look's, and the others are chosen to stay apart from it and from each other, also for the common forms of color blindness, with enough contrast on that appearance's background. Until now charts were the same blue in every accent and look.

**Also fixed**

- The ER diagram's zoom buttons, minimap and selection box take the look's colors (they stayed white, most visibly in Medieval).
- The assistant's team tools (`tools/*.sql` in a knowledge base) are read like the folder's other files: never through a link out of the folder, and not beyond the size limit.

Everything new in 1.5 is in the [1.5.0 notes](https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind/releases/tag/v1.5.0).

Updates itself on Windows (installer), macOS and Linux (AppImage). The [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p0grd7bz4nf) version updates through the Store.

## Download

| | |
|---|---|
| Windows, signed by Microsoft | [Microsoft Store](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9p0grd7bz4nf) |
| Windows, no installation | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.4-win-x64-portable.zip`: unzip and run `DB Mastermind.exe` |
| Windows installer (no admin, updates itself) | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.4-win-x64-setup.exe` |
| Windows for IT (per machine) | `DB-Mastermind-1.5.4-win-x64.msi` |
| Windows via Scoop | `scoop install https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind/releases/latest/download/db-mastermind.json` |
| macOS | `…-mac-arm64.dmg` (Apple Silicon) / `…-mac-x64.dmg` (Intel), or `brew tap elh0m3r0/db-mastermind https://github.com/eLh0m3r0/db-mastermind && brew install --cask db-mastermind`. First launch: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway (the app is not notarized yet) |
| Linux | `DB-Mastermind-linux-x86_64.AppImage` (updates itself; needs FUSE 2, `libfuse2t64` on Ubuntu 24.04) or `.deb` |
| MCP server and command line | `npx -y dbmastermind-mcp` · `npx -p dbmastermind-mcp dbm` |
